column1: # Per-row disposition overrides: authored input to the P1 census generator.
# Three tab-separated fields: <row id> <disposition> <reason>.
# An override is for a row whose enclosing section's disposition does not
# describe it. It beats every line in dispositions.tsv. An override that no
# row matches fails generation, so an entry cannot outlive its row.
# The reference algorithm that realizes the piping requirements. Its enclosing
# section rs-all-abstract-ops is owned; SPEC-MANIFEST.md dispositions
# ReadableStreamPipeTo itself as requirement.
op.readable-stream-pipe-to
column3: SPEC-MANIFEST.md dispositions ReadableStreamPipeTo as the reference algorithm realizing the piping requirements
